title: Employee / Technician Identifiers
description: The numbers CDK uses to say who wrote up the RO, who turned the wrench, who sold the part, and who took the payment.
x-sap-analogue: HR-adjacent Z-fields stamped onto transaction tables (no clean SAP HR master analogue)
x-api-note: CDK Get Employee is announced by name but has no public field-level schema; the richest documented employee fields live inside the Repair Order v3 payload, not a dedicated employee API.
x-confidence-legend: Every property carries x-confidence: documented | inferred | unverified, copied from docs/model/model.json field-level confidence -- never uniform across an entity.
